reproduction.expected: An operator can initialize one verified project Host installation and run the existing ChatGPT/Codex Host transport through a repository-owned concrete factory without hand-writing Python assembly code.
reproduction.actual: The Host CLI requires a trusted factory, but no concrete factory or project initializer assembles the verified Starter registration, Provider registry, durable checkpointer, and Orchestrator.

violated_invariants: Supported Hosts need one concrete bootstrap over the already verified control-plane components.
Project initialization must generate reviewable configuration rather than requiring handwritten assembly code.
Bootstrap must not grant write, completion, release, or merge authority.
